key_insight: A Zn-based compliant interlayer, especially when paired with a Zn/Cu transition layer, enables much stronger and more durable metallic coatings on CFRP than simpler interlayers.
engineering_relevance: This multilayer metallization approach improves adhesion and electrical functionality for aerospace CFRP, making it promising for lightning strike protection while preserving lightweight structures.
method: Deposit Zn, Zn/Al, or Zn/Cu interlayers on CFRP by arc wire spraying (AWS).
Apply Al or Cu topcoats using high-pressure cold spraying (HPCS).
Compare coating integrity and adhesion using pull-off tests and microstructural analysis.
evidence_signal: Pull-off testing showed Zn interlayers near ~7 MPa versus ~4–5 MPa for Zn/Al, with Al topcoats reaching 8.4 MPa and Cu topcoats reaching 12.1 MPa on optimized multilayer stacks.
watch_item: Thermal and mechanical compatibility with CFRP remains critical, so process control is needed to avoid substrate damage and ensure consistent interfacial bonding.
paper_title: Metallization on CFRP: Effect of Interlayers and Deposition Methods for Aerospace Applications
